{{Quote|You did well to find the connection with Centax Two, but if you keep crashing around you're going to get caught, so I'll save you some time. Yes, there are clones now being produced in facilities outside Kamino&mdash;some here, most on Centax, and a ''lot'' of them. No, the Grand Army command hasn't been told, because those Jedi generals will want the extra men to deploy right away, but they won't get them.|[[Valaqil]], to [[Besany Wennen]]|<ref name="TC" />}}
'''Centax-2''',<ref name="TGAotR">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-7-the-grand-army-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 7 &mdash; The Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> also spelled as '''Centax 2''',<ref name="Deceptions" /><ref name="Order" /><ref name="Bloodlines" /> '''Centax II'''<ref name="TC" /> and '''Centax Two''',<ref name="TC" /><ref name="Order" /> and also known simply as '''Centax''',<ref name="TC" /><ref name="Order" /><ref name="Bloodlines" /> was one of the four [[Moon/Legends|moons]]<ref name="CatCW" /> of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Deceptions" />

==History==
{{Dialogue|Valaqil|Very soon, Palpatine will unleash a huge clone army, the one he's been building on Centax Two.|Wennen|We worked that out.|Valaqil|He's not preparing to use it against the Separatists.|Ordo|What makes you say that?|Valaqil|Because I have been to Centax Two, and I have seen deployment plans, to ensure that Qiilura wasn't on the list.|Ordo|Want to expand on that?|Valaqil|Soldier, you can't even see what's in front of you, can you?|Ordo|So what troop strengths are we talking about? What targets?|Valaqil|Enough to occupy thousands of worlds.|attr=[[Valaqil]], [[Besany Wennen]] and [[Ordo Skirata]]|src=<ref name="Order" />}}
[[File:Coruscant_system-TPM.jpg|thumb|left|285px|The planet Coruscant and three of its four moons]]
In [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]], [[Clee Rhara]] tried to establish a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Jedi Starfighter Corps|corps]] on Centax-2, but the project was canceled by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] after it was sabotaged by [[Vox Chun]] and [[Tarrence Chenati]].<ref name="Deceptions" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Centax-2 was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for military staging and [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] maintenance. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Besany Wennen]] was investigating future [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] payments for [[Mereel Skirata]] but instead found out that [[Spaarti cloning cylinder|Spaarti cloning facilities]] were being built on Centax-2, and that [[Arkanian Microtechnologies]] was permitted to establish facilities there.<ref name="TC" />

Centax-2 was also the location of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] secret [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Army/Legends|army]].

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Blockade of Corellia]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Centax-2 hosted a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] starfighter [[training squadron]] base and was used by the [[New Jedi Order]] as a training facility.<ref name="Bloodlines" />
